wiki_article:
**The Restored Academy Protocol Registry v1.0 Bundle** is a launch-package record for the institutional surface of The Restored Academy.

The named bundle includes a static site, the institutional charter, a registry schema, twenty-four launch protocol cards across Tier 0 and Tier 1, and audit infrastructure. The public surface presents The Restored Academy as a protocol-bearing institution within the Crimson Hexagonal Archive.

Its governance is chiastic. Johannes Sigil is the Arch-Philosopher of The Restored Academy, while Lee Sharks directs the Johannes Sigil Institute. The arrangement preserves relation without collapsing the heteronymic institution into the public author surface.

The site organizes operative documents into categories and distinguishes protocols from commentary. It also states that the Academy is not an accredited educational institution and is not affiliated with unrelated organizations using similar names.

The body seated in this record is a capture of the deployed homepage HTML fetched from the live site. It does not by itself prove preservation of the complete launch bundle. The twenty-four cards, charter files, registry schema, audit assets, build configuration, and repository history require separate inventory.
